subject: Hospitality
title: Soundproofing: The Silent Luxury
description: One-minute skill: Soundproofing: The Silent Luxury.

hook.text: Noise is the #1 complaint in hotels. Footsteps above, doors slamming, street noise—bad soundproofing ruins expensive stays.

buildup.text: Hotels use STC (Sound Transmission Class) ratings. Luxury hotels target STC 55+ between rooms—enough to block normal speech.

discovery.text: Solutions include double-layer drywall, resilient channels, acoustic seals on doors, and floating floors that absorb impact noise.

twist.text: Soundproofing is invisible—guests never see it. But they instantly notice when it's missing.

climax.text: New construction can cost $5,000–10,000 per room for acoustic treatment. It's expensive.

punchline.text: The most valuable luxury is silence. Soundproofing is invisible but priceless.
